description: This file defines the SecureSocketPort class and its nested classes and interfaces, which are responsible for managing secure socket connections, including certificate handling, validation, and socket state management within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort
classes.description: Represents a secure socket port with capabilities for opening, closing, and data transmission, including nested classes for certificate management and validation.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate
classes.description: Encapsulates an X.509 certificate and its associated SSL context, providing methods to retrieve issuer, subject, validity period, hostname validation, and verification.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::IValidator
classes.description: Interface for validating certificates, allowing custom validation logic.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler
classes.description: Manages the socket connection state, data transmission, and handshake validation, inheriting from Core::SocketPort.

methods.name: Certificate::Issuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer of the certificate.

methods.name: Certificate::Subject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the certificate.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidFrom
methods.description: Returns the start of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidTill
methods.description: Returns the end of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidHostname
methods.description: Checks if the certificate is valid for the expected hostname.

methods.name: Certificate::Verify
methods.description: Verifies the certificate and returns success or error message.

methods.name: Handler::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the socket handler.

methods.name: Handler::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket buffer.

methods.name: Handler::Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket buffer.

methods.name: Handler::Open
methods.description: Opens the socket connection with a wait time.

methods.name: Handler::Close
methods.description: Closes the socket connection with a wait time.

methods.name: Handler::Update
methods.description: Updates the socket state.

methods.name: Handler::ValidateHandShake
methods.description: Validates the handshake process.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Callback
methods.description: Sets or gets the callback validator for the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the socket is open.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the socket is closed.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the socket is suspended.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::HasError
methods.description: Checks if the socket has an error.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier of the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier of the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::LocalNode
methods.description: Sets the local node information.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::RemoteNode
methods.description: Sets the remote node information.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::RemoteNode (getter)
methods.description: Returns the remote node information.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Open
methods.description: Opens the socket connection.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Close
methods.description: Closes the socket connection.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Trigger
methods.description: Triggers socket events.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the resource descriptor.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Events
methods.description: Returns the resource events.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handle
methods.description: Handles resource events.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::SendData
methods.description: Sends data through the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications.
